SOW No.: PVHS-FSS/2025/HAT-002
Between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions (“Vendor”) and FinSecure Services (“Client”)

source_location.excerpt:
SOW No.: PVHS-FSS/2025/HAT-002
Between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions (“Vendor”) and FinSecure Services (“Client”)

clauses.text: 1.1 This Statement of Work (“SOW”) is issued pursuant to the Master Services Agreement (“MSA”) executed between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions, incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (“Vendor”), and FinSecure Services, a BFSI company with headquarters at [Address] (“Client”).

source_location.excerpt: 1.1 This Statement of Work (“SOW”) is issued pursuant to the Master Services Agreement (“MSA”) executed between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions, incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (“Vendor”), and FinSecure Services, a BFSI company with headquarters at [Address] (“Client”).

clauses.text: 1.2 The purpose of this SOW is to define the detailed scope, technical specifications, deliverables, timelines, quality standards, acceptance criteria, training, warranties, and risk mitigation measures for the design, manufacture, supply, integration, and maintenance of Secure Hardware Authentication Terminals (HAT-900 Series) for FinSecure Services’ branch offices and corporate operations.

source_location.excerpt: 1.2 The purpose of this SOW is to define the detailed scope, technical specifications, deliverables, timelines, quality standards, acceptance criteria, training, warranties, and risk mitigation measures for the design, manufacture, supply, integration, and maintenance of Secure Hardware Authentication Terminals (HAT-900 Series) for FinSecure Services’ branch offices and corporate operations.

clauses.text: 1.3 The SOW is supplemental to the MSA; in case of conflict, the MSA shall prevail except where explicitly modified herein.

source_location.excerpt: 1.3 The SOW is supplemental to the MSA; in case of conflict, the MSA shall prevail except where explicitly modified herein.

clauses.text: “Hardware Units”: HAT-900 Series secure authentication terminals.

source_location.excerpt: “Hardware Units”: HAT-900 Series secure authentication terminals.

clauses.text: “Integration Services”: Activities required to integrate Hardware Units with FinSecure’s Identity Access Management (IAM) and transaction systems.

source_location.excerpt: “Integration Services”: Activities required to integrate Hardware Units with FinSecure’s Identity Access Management (IAM) and transaction systems.

clauses.text: “Acceptance Testing”: Testing procedure described in Section 6, which must be completed prior to Client’s formal acceptance.

source_location.excerpt: “Acceptance Testing”: Testing procedure described in Section 6, which must be completed prior to Client’s formal acceptance.

clauses.text: “Firmware”: Embedded software running on the HAT devices, including security modules, encryption protocols, and communication firmware.

source_location.excerpt: “Firmware”: Embedded software running on the HAT devices, including security modules, encryption protocols, and communication firmware.

clauses.text: “CR / Change Request”: Any modification to scope, timeline, or cost requiring mutual written consent.

clauses.text: “Maintenance Services”: Activities related to preventive, corrective, and patch management support post-deployment.

clauses.text: 5” color touchscreen with resistive/ capacitive input
